notes: Extension components for the information_motion presentation only. The frozen v0.2 registry (component-registry-v0.2.json) is unchanged; g1/video_ir.load_registry() merges these entries. big_number reveals title, then line:0 (value), line:1 (label) and line:2 (note, if present): the frozen beat target pattern has no other names. price_change reveals title and one row per line:N (1-2 rows). source_card reveals title and one source per line:N; its props come from the request's sources, never from the model.
